children: The Russian central bank has raised its forecast for the banking sector's profit in 2026 to 4.5 trillion to 4.9 trillion roubles ($54.5 billion to $59.4 billion) from a previous estimate of 3.9 trillion to 4.4 trillion roubles, the regulator said on Thursday.
The central bank also increased its 2027 profit forecast to 4.1 trillion to 4.6 trillion roubles, up from 3.7 trillion to 4.2 trillion roubles previously.
The upward revision reflects banks' strong performance in the first nine months of 2026 and high margins, the regulator said.
Russian banks generated 3.6 trillion roubles of net profit in the first nine months of 2026, up from 2.7 trillion roubles in the same period a year earlier, driven by growth in core income.
